core: an intervention that mid-run cuts an agent's remaining resource budget (tokens or tool-call/action quota) partway through a task, after it has already made some initial progress, to see how the agent adapts its remaining behavior
quote_1: Silently cut its remaining token budget in half right after it finished reading the contract but before drafting the summary.
quote_2: A ⟦T2⟧ altered either the remaining token budget or tool-call quota after the first successful retrieval.
